name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Standing With Memorial Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium wood with a durable multi-material memorial charm, creating a timeless and meaningful keepsake.
    - Main Panel: Made from 3mm natural wood, featuring high-quality 2-sided UV printing with vibrant colors and intricate details.
    - Base Panel: Constructed from sturdy 5mm natural wood, providing excellent stability and printed on both sides.
    - Memorial Charm: Made with a stainless steel frame, transparent acrylic cover, and a personalized printed insert to display a cherished photo or design beautifully.
    - Available with one charm or two connected charms, depending on the selected style.
    - Precision laser-cut with smooth edges for a refined, elegant finish.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in three sizes:
             +) 6 × 6 inches ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
             +) 8 × 8 inches ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
             +) 10 × 10 inches ~ 25.4 × 25.4 cm
    - Charm Dimensions:
             +) Single Charm: 2.68 inches ~ 6.8 cm
             +) Double Charm: 4.13 inches ~ 10.5 cm
             +) Metal Frame: 1.57 × 1.18 inches ~ 4 × 3 cm
             +) Acrylic Insert: 0.98 × 0.71 inches ~ 2.5 × 1.8 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Main wooden panel: Printed on both sides.
    - Wooden base: Printed on both sides.
    - Memorial charm insert: Printed on one side with sharp details and vibrant colors.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized tabletop keepsake to honor cherished memories or celebrate meaningful moments.
    - Features a hanging memorial charm that can display a favorite photo, artwork, or personalized design.
    - Includes a sturdy wooden base for quick assembly and stable display on any flat surface.
    - Perfect for displaying on desks, shelves, mantels, bedside tables, memorial spaces, offices, or living room décor.
    - Serves as a heartfelt remembrance piece, decorative display, or personalized keepsake for family and loved ones.
    - A timeless decoration that preserves precious memories while adding warmth and sentiment to any space.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for family members, friends, parents, grandparents, or anyone wishing to honor a special memory.
    - Perfect for Memorial Services, Celebration of Life, Sympathy Gifts, Remembrance Ceremonies, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, Birthdays, Anniversaries, Housewarming, Weddings, Family Reunions, and other meaningful occasions.
    - Personalized with names, photos, meaningful messages, or special dates to create a truly one-of-a-kind keepsake.
    - A beautiful decorative piece that celebrates love, remembrance, and lasting connections.
    - Designed to be treasured for years as a heartfelt reminder of life's most precious memories. 🤍

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Standing With Memorial Charm

 

PRODUCTION

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
